description: This file defines structures, macros, and assembly routines related to interrupt stacking and context saving for RISC-V architecture in Nordic Semiconductor's Zephyr-based project. It includes conditional definitions based on bus width (32 or 64-bit) and assembly language support.

methods.name: SOC_ISR_STACKING_ESF_DECLARE
methods.description: Macro defining the structure of the exception stack frame (ESF) with different layouts for 32-bit and 64-bit bus widths.

methods.name: SOC_ISR_SW_STACKING
methods.description: Assembly macro for saving context during an interrupt or exception, handling both cases based on cause register.

methods.name: SOC_ISR_SW_UNSTACKING
methods.description: Assembly macro for restoring context after an interrupt or exception.
